svg.aria-label: Kbd dimensional drawing: intrinsic keycap sizing, icon-only dimensions, size inheritance, sequence group layout and exploded paint layers

g.text: SCALE 5.5:1 IN HEIGHT · SM · GLYPH + LABEL · WIDTH SCHEMATIC
H1 = 2·S2 + L1 = 16 NOMINAL WITH TEXT; CONTENT MAY INCREASE HEIGHT.

svg.text: ONE DOM BOX: OUTLINE AND FILL ARE SEPARATED FOR STUDY.
NO DEFAULT BORDER, SHADOW, PORTAL OR PRESS ANIMATION.
TEXT NEVER WRAPS; WIDTH HUGS CONTENT.
SEMANTIC KBD; ASCHILD MERGES ONTO A CHILD.
NO DEFAULT TAB STOP OR KEY LISTENER.
EXPLICIT CHILD / NESTED GROUP SIZE WINS.
PLATFORM CHANGES LABELS, NOT THE SIZE MAP.
FILL CHANGES; GEOMETRY STAYS THE SAME.
SCALE 5:1 · SM / MD · DEFAULT SVG SIZE, NO TEXT
EXPLICIT SVG SIZE / WIDTH / HEIGHT CLASSES OVERRIDE THE 1em RULE.
TEXT + GLYPH USES THE TALLER CHILD; CUSTOM CONTENT CAN GROW H1.
SCALE 3:1 IN HEIGHT · SM · ALL CONTENT WIDTHS SCHEMATIC
CHORDS FLATTEN INTO ONE FLEX ROW; SPACES INSERT SEQUENCE SEPARATORS.
NO GROUP WRAP RULE; OVERFLOW AND AVAILABLE WIDTH BELONG TO THE CALLER.
SOURCE: KBD + VARIANTS + KEYS · SLOT / CN · GLOBALS.CSS · LIVE SM / MD / GLYPH / SEQUENCE MEASUREMENTS
SCHEMATIC · KEYS TAKE PRECEDENCE OVER CHILDREN
